THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT(CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE
LAND ACQUISTION (AMENDMENT)
ACT No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: BD/UP/LND.1/UO/1/10/04.Ministry of Land Reference No.: 4/3/9/2011/IR/07.
I hereby notice, under the Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of theLand Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquirethe following land which is required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land to be acquired:

Two (02) allotments of Lots in total extent of about 0.0756Hectares, Shown as Lot No. 414 to 415, Depicted in thePreliminary Plan No. FVP 48, Sheet 08, Supplement 12, Dated31st May 2016 prepared by the Surveyor General, situated inthe village of Kotawera Udagama in Kotawera Udagama GramaNiladhari Division of Dehivinipalatha Korale Minor Division,in the Uvaparanagama Divisional Secretary’s Division, in theDistrict of Badulla in Uva Province, More fully Described below.
01. Lot No. 414Name of the Land: Badiarawatta; Description: Home Garden;Claimed by: Mrs. Abekoon Mudiyanselage Premawathi,
Resident of Badiarawatta, Ihala Kotawera, Welimada; Extent:0.0478 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 415Name of the Land: Badiarawatta; Description: Home Garden;Claimed by: Mr. Thennakoon Mudiyanselage Nimal, Residentof A1/28, Umanadi, Moragolla, Welimada; Extent: 0.0278Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby,required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized inwriting, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Uvaparanagamaon the day and time relevant to each land lot as writing (induplicate) on or before the 22nd of May 2017, the nature ofthier interests in the land, the particulars of their claims forcompensation for the auquisition of the said land, the amountof compensation and the details of the computation of suchamount.
Date: 22.05.2017, Time: 9.30 a.m., Lot Nos. From 414 to 415.
J. M. CHAMILA INDIKA JAYASINGHE,
Divisional Secretary,
Uvaparanagama.
Divisional Secretary’s OfficeUvaparanagama, Lunuwatta,21th of April, 2017.
